{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Bernie Sanders states that healthcare is a right for everyone regardless of status.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Bernie Sanders’ immigration plan calls for a moratorium on deportations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The immigration plan is a commitment to equal treatment of immigrants who come into contact with the criminal justice system, regardless of immigration status.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The plan represents a complete rejection of policies from Donald Trump and Stephen Miller.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The plan has earned Bernie Sanders support from Mijente, Make the Road Action and Center for Popular Democracy Action.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Faiz Shakir stated that the deportation moratorium would affect 99% of the people living in the country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Faiz Shakir stated that the deportation moratorium would not apply to “violent criminals”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Faiz Shakir stated that some incarcerated people’s deportations would be decided “on a case by case basis”.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Faiz Shakir’s comments contradict Bernie Sanders’ position.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Faiz Shakir’s comments undermine the ability to implement a full moratorium on deportations.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
